A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (15 October 2024). Its words are Decipher's errata from the Glossary Supplement (29 January 2002).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Ref2-L-miraxterrik-PC-Errata-2024-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Mirax Terrik (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same words as the previous version. This is a full card image again, drawn anew at 745 × 1039 pixels, with the mark “D-E1” in the lower border.

The 2017 slip and the same area of the 2024 D-E1 card, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
